observations: Photo 0 shows a white industrial iron base unit with a chrome iron head resting on top.
The brand 'BABY VAPOR' is clearly visible in black letters on the front of the base unit.
There are two red switches labeled 'FERRO' and 'CALDAIA', and a red switch labeled 'SPIA VAPORE'.
The iron head has a cork handle, a red lever, and a dial with temperature settings.
The base unit has a black handle on top, a coiled black power cord, and a plug with a three-pronged European-style connector.
A CE mark is visible on the top right of the base unit.
The unit is placed on a concrete surface, suggesting outdoor or workshop setting.
The iron head has some text on the soleplate, possibly 'ACCOLLATO-CE', but it is partially obscured.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the brand 'BABY VAPOR' on the unit. The CE mark and European plug suggest European origin, consistent with 'Made in Italy'.
